title: QuarrionCraft SMP
description: A crossplay, and most version supported, vanilla server with little to no restriction.
body:
Java + Bedrock • 1.7 - 26.x


QuarrionCraft is a smaller vanilla+ survival server built around genuine Minecraft multiplayer.


Our golden rule: stay close to the original game while supporting smooth crossplay and long-term accessibility;
No plugin soup. No economy. No RTP/TPA. No pay-to-win. No overwhelming menus or constant advertisements. Just Minecraft with it's essential seasoning.

This isn't a true anarchy, nor a heavily grief-protected/friendly server- It's just neutral Minecraft;
Gameplay intentionally lightly restricted to preserve player freedom and open-world survival. PvP, raiding, and player-driven conflict are part of the world.




...Have fun, birbs!
